## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The invite validator still accepts eight-character passwords, so the twelve-character minimum is not enforced on every path that sets a password; this needs fixing.

## Changes
This pull request raises `MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH` from 8 to 12 in `app/reset.py` and `app/signup.py`, and updates both boundary tests to check lengths 11, 12 and 13. It also adds a one-line `review.txt` file.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/signup.py:1 — correctness — Raise the invite validator's minimum to twelve — The PR body says it "raises the minimum in the password validators", and this line raises signup to 12, but `app/invite.py:1` still sets `MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH = 8`, so `app.invite.accepts_password("x" * 8)` returns `True`. `tests/test_invite.py:6-8` still asserts the old `length >= 8` rule. — Users who sign up through an invitation can still set 8 to 11 character passwords, which breaks the stated security policy. — Fix: Set `app/invite.py:1` to 12 and update the parametrization and expected result in `tests/test_invite.py:6` to match the reset and signup tests.
